title: Colorado all clear at the moment
snippet: No new developments with wildfire smoke across Colorado as the workweek gets started. Heavy smoke remains bottled up across the Pacific Northwest while ample moisture in Colorado is stopping any development or intensification of local wildfires. There is a possibility for some out-of-state smoke to move into northeastern Colorado (including the Denver/Boulder/Ft. Collins urban corridor) late Wednesday into early Thursday. However, still plenty of uncertainty with that scenario so we will…
